crossRefs.note: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
“Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
“ ‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not…

translations.web: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.
translations.bsb: because he did not kill me in the womb so that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb forever enlarged.
translations.kjv: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great
translations.asv: because he slew me not from the womb; and so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.
